headline: Hawaii Hilo's third straight defeat levels their record
dek: Hawaii Hilo have not won since their opening matches, and the defeat at MSU Denver is their third in succession. Three wins and three defeats, and not a draw among them, is the record they carry into Pacific West Conference play.
displaced_by: results night: Hawaii Hilo's third defeat in succession, at MSU Denver, leaves them level at three wins and three losses
